workloads.name: Enterprise knowledge retrieval
workloads.description: Searching, extracting and reasoning over internal documents, policies, contracts and data using RAG. The first pattern most enterprises adopt and where most production deployments sit.

workloads.name: Content generation
workloads.description: Creating, summarising, translating and transforming text. Where most organisations began; now giving way to data-grounded, higher-value work.

workloads.name: Autonomous multi-step execution
workloads.description: Agents that plan, reason, call tools and execute workflows across systems: claims processing, compliance review, credit analysis, analytics pipelines, backend orchestration. Maturity varies widely between vendors.

workloads.name: Domain model adaptation
workloads.description: Fine-tuning, custom embeddings, prompt optimisation and evaluation tailored to an industry. Used where domain accuracy is business-critical.

workloads.name: Multimodal processing
workloads.description: Reasoning across text, images, audio and video, including OCR plus LLM pipelines and document digitisation.

agentic: Multi-step underwriting with triage and scoring
